models.name: Dell PowerEdge T160
models.shortDescription: An entry tower server on Intel Xeon 6 with up to three cabled SATA drives and iDRAC9 Enterprise, for a first server in an office rather than a rack.
models.description:
The PowerEdge T160 is Dell's entry tower server: a single Intel Xeon 6 processor, four DIMM slots and up to three cabled 3.5-inch SATA drives in a 300 W chassis. It suits a first file, print or line-of-business server in an office where there is no rack and no one to manage one full time.

Every build listed includes iDRAC9 Enterprise, which is the part that matters after the sale — remote console, power control and alerting without a site visit. Support is ProSupport Next Business Day.
businessFeatures: iDRAC9 Enterprise remote management on every build
Tower chassis for an office without a rack

models.shortDescription: A dual-socket 2U rack server with redundant power, in eight-bay 2.5-inch and twelve-bay 3.5-inch chassis, for consolidation and virtualisation.

The PowerEdge R760 is the mainstream dual-socket 2U server: thirty-two DIMM slots, redundant hot-plug power supplies and a choice of an eight-bay 2.5-inch chassis with universal SAS/SATA/NVMe slots or a twelve-bay 3.5-inch chassis.
